items.hook: Juice to fly past Earth for third gravity assist
items.body: The European Space Agency’s Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer ( Juice ) will return to Earth on 28 September, with flight controllers guiding the spacecraft close to our home planet to alter its speed and direction en route to Jupiter.
